snapshots.name: ASML
snapshots.trade_note: Nasdaq listing of the Dutch semiconductor equipment maker; ASML also trades as ASML on Euronext Amsterdam in EUR.

snapshots.name: Bitcoin
snapshots.trade_note: Revolut crypto fees run up to 1.49% depending on plan — far higher than its equity commissions. Factor that into any short-horizon idea.

snapshots.name: CRH
snapshots.trade_note: Irish-founded building materials group; primary listing moved to the NYSE in 2023, so US data covers it.

snapshots.name: EUR/USD
snapshots.trade_note: Not something to trade here — tracked because it moves the EUR value of every USD-denominated holding above. Forex is on Twelve Data's free tier.

snapshots.name: Euro Stoxx 50
snapshots.trade_note: iShares Core EURO STOXX 50 UCITS ETF (Acc). EUR-denominated index, so no currency mismatch for you.

snapshots.name: FTSE All-World
snapshots.trade_note: Vanguard FTSE All-World UCITS ETF (Acc). Includes emerging markets, unlike MSCI World.

snapshots.name: Flutter Entertainment
snapshots.trade_note: Irish-headquartered; primary listing is now the NYSE.

snapshots.name: Gold
snapshots.trade_note: iShares Physical Gold ETC — an ETC, not a UCITS ETF. Revolut also sells gold directly as a commodity; check which route your account offers.

snapshots.name: MSCI World
snapshots.trade_note: iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF (Acc). Also listed as IWDA on Euronext Amsterdam.

snapshots.name: Nasdaq 100
snapshots.trade_note: iShares Nasdaq 100 UCITS ETF (Acc), also listed as CNDX. Invesco EQQQ (IE0032077012) is the common alternative.

snapshots.name: Nvidia
snapshots.trade_note: High realised volatility; the 5% daily-move rule will fire often here.

snapshots.name: Ryanair
snapshots.trade_note: Nasdaq ADR. Revolut EEA also lists RYA on Euronext Dublin in EUR — the ADR is not 1:1 with the ordinary share, so pick one and stay with it.

snapshots.name: S&P 500
snapshots.trade_note: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF (Acc). Also listed as CSPX. US-listed SPY is not available to EEA retail.
